memory_candidates.content: When verifying a git-staging/commit fix, a script that merely lists staged paths does not prove isolation. Build a scratch harness that actually runs the real commit script (e.g. git-commit-scoped.sh) sequentially for two synthetic tasks and assert on `git show --name-only --format= <ref>` of the resulting real commits in both directions (each contains its own file, neither contains the sibling's). To exercise an ephemeral-file exclusion pathspec meaningfully, the excluded file must already be tracked AND dirtied before the commit under test -- an untouched tracked file or a never-tracked file doesn't exercise the exclusion logic at all.

scripts/deploy-root-guard.sh requires any script sourcing it to live two directories under a `.claude` or `.opencode` parent (i.e. at `<root>/.claude/scripts/foo.sh`), because those scripts resolve their own repo root as `${SCRIPT_DIR}/../..`. A scratch test harness for such a script must mirror this exact deployed layout (`<scratch>/.claude/scripts/`), not just copy the script to an arbitrary directory.
